why: New electronic identity card with a qualified certificate may be the same measure as the eID cards issued by the Public Services Agency.
Sources call the modernised Public Services Portal the "integrated EVO portal"; EVO may now be the portal itself.
Sources describe the national digital wallet as "EVO Sign" or EVOSign "as a digital identity wallet".
December 2025 amendments to Law No. 124/2022 may be Law No. 117/2025.
The "second protocol" to Convention 108 ratified in 2026 may be the amending Protocol CETS No. 223.
Council on AI and Data Governance (SCIA) may be the sub-council of the digital transformation council.
National Council for Digitalisation (MEDD Order No. 165/2023) may be the National Digital Transformation Council.
HRMIS in IO sources may be the SI EMRU human resources system.
E-Legiferare and the e-Legislation IT system may be one system.
Draft law on technology sandboxes and draft law on testing and innovation spaces in AI may be one draft.
particip.gov.md and the e-Democracy platform both serve public consultation; relation not stated.
"Migration" Information System and the "Migration and asylum" system may be one system.
The IGM information system may be the "Migration" Information System.
New normative act on the regime of foreigners may be the draft law on the admission, stay and supervision of foreigners.
Law of July 2025 giving EU citizens a different regime may be Law No. 200/2025.
2023 amendments to Law No. 200/2010 may be Law No. 38/2023.
2023 amendments to Law No. 200/2010 may be Law No. 203/2023.
Amendments in force January 2024 may be Law No. 203/2023.
Law on Information Society Services is stated as "formerly the Law on Electronic Commerce"; it may be Law No. 284/2004 renamed.
National Cyber Security Strategy may be the National Information Security Strategy 2019-2024.
Voluntary operator roaming agreement and the temporary roaming tariff reduction mechanism 2024-2025 may be one arrangement.
Inclusion of roaming in the Association Agreement may be Association Council Decision No. 1/2025 amending Annex XXVIII-B.
Moldova's inclusion in the Roam Like at Home area follows Association Council Decision No. 1/2025; kept apart as decision and effect.
National Action Plan for accession 2024-2027 may be an earlier name of the National Programme for Accession 2025-2029.
Digital transformation concept and strategic vision were preparatory to the Digital Transformation Strategy 2023-2030.
Items naming the personal data protection law without a number may refer to Law No. 133/2011.
Items naming the personal data protection law without a number may refer to Law No. 195/2024.
Draft Electronic Communications Law approved by the Government in March 2025 is probably the draft of Law No. 72/2025; kept apart under the draft-and-adopted rule.
Draft law on access to property and use of infrastructure is probably the draft of Law No. 106/2026; kept apart under the draft-and-adopted rule.
Draft open data law is probably the draft of Law No. 109/2025; kept apart under the draft-and-adopted rule.
Draft law on personal data protection (pending since 2018) may be an earlier draft of Law No. 195/2024; kept apart under the draft-and-adopted rule.
Draft law on the new electronic identity card may have become Law No. 68/2024; kept apart under the draft-and-adopted rule.
Draft and adopted amendments of Government Decision No. 211/2019 may be the same act at two stages.
Two Government Decisions are named for the cybersecurity coordinating council; relation not stated.
e-services.md (PSA services only) is kept apart from the government services portal, as the source describes them as two portals.
Bureau of Migration and Asylum (2023 EU material) and General Inspectorate for Migration may be predecessor and successor; no succession is stated.
